notes.title: Ver.1.0.1: Bug Fixes for Online Matches
notes.notes: [p]The [i]holoReversi[/i] Ver.1.0.1 update is now live![/p][p]The following issues have been addressed in this update:[/p][p][/p][p]/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_[/p][p]▼ Update Details[/p][p]・【Online Match – Game Freeze Bug】[/p][p]Fixed an issue where activating certain skills during online matches could cause the game to become unresponsive.[/p][p][/p][p]・【Online Match – Player Name Display Bug】[/p][p]Fixed a bug where player names appeared as “unknown” during casual matches.[/p][p][/p][p]・【Online Match – Game Modes】[/p][p]In addition to “Score Battle,” players can now also select “Count Battle” and “Classic Reversi.”[/p][p]Other minor updates[/p][p][/p][p]・Some new voice lines have been added.[/p][p][/p][p]/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_/_[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of holoReversi![/p]
